violation_type.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))
violation_type.short_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space
violation_type.typical_finding: Cots for napping were arranged next to each other in a way that did not allow for children nor caregivers to walk in between without stepping on cots to get to walkway.

finding_variants.text: Cots for napping were arranged next to each other in a way that did not allow for children nor caregivers to walk in between without stepping on cots to get to walkway.
There was not sufficient walking space between each childs cot during naptime in the two and three year old classrooms.
Three classrooms were observed with nap mat placed right next to one another.
Several cots were observed to be too close together and did not provide adequate walking space for staff or children.
There was not sufficient walking space between nap cots in one room.     This was corrected at inpection when it was addressed with the caregivers in the room as well as the director.
The cots in the mixed age group during naptime did not have enough space in between each cot. The cots were touching each other.
